origin: Own exact two-solute equilibrium chromatography model in dimensionless units. All batch data, detector standards and effluent signals are constructed mathematical observations, not measurements of a named molecule or column. Signals with irrational plateau concentrations are supplied to 78 decimal digits; treat the stated numerical tolerance rather than converting rounded decimals into a new exact physical model.
equilibrium_and_transport: Two adsorbates with nonnegative mobile concentrations c1,c2 share one competitive Langmuir site family: q_i=Q*b_i*c_i/(1+b1*c1+b2*c2), with unknown positive Q, b1, b2 shared by all rows. After calibration, call the lower-affinity b_i species weak and the higher-affinity species strong, preserving numeric species labels. The stationary-to-mobile phase ratio and mobile velocity are each 1. Conserved column storage is u_i(c)=c_i+q_i(c), not mobile concentration alone. The ideal plug-flow equations are partial_t u_i(c)+partial_z c_i=0 on a column of length1, no axial dispersion and no finite adsorption kinetics. At t=0 the column is empty c=(0,0). For all t>0 the inlet is held at c=(1,1), with open outflow at z=1. This is continuous frontal loading, not a finite pulse elution.
batch_isotherm_calibration: The batch CSV contains four exact positive mixture concentrations and both equilibrium adsorbed loadings, in shuffled order. Infer ALL parameters from ALL rows and both species. Reciprocal relations c_i/q_i are affine in(1,c1,c2); fit the two species together or separately using complete registered least-squares outputs, including every coefficient, rank and residual. Verify the nonlinear shared-capacity model and cross-coefficient consistency in the original q equations; two unrelated affine fits are not enough to establish a thermodynamically common site family. Distinguish the total stored amountu from either mobilec or stationaryq.
detector_calibration: The second CSV gives four known concentration standards and two signals. The detector has one unknown invertible 2x2 matrix M, no offset, and reports y=M*c. Fit all standards and both channels with full registered least-squares outputs. Retain an actual registered inverse of the complete fitted M. The third CSV supplies column effluent signals at elapsed times[0.5,1.4,1.5,1.8,2]; use a registered matrix product of the ACTUAL returned detector inverse with the COMPLETE 2x5 signal matrix, preserving time and channel identities. These observations check the predicted profile; a detector signal alone cannot identify which solute overshoots its feed.
bounded_front_selection_problem: Construct and certify the self-similar two-front displacement solution with constant feed stateL=(1,1), empty stateR=(0,0), and one intermediate state containing ONLY ONE species. The two front positions are z=s_trailing*t and z=s_leading*t with 0<s_trailing<s_leading. This explicit candidate class is part of the question: test BOTH possible pure intermediate species and ALL algebraic concentrations given by the full two-component Rankine-Hugoniot equations s*(u_left-u_right)=c_left-c_right. Retain complete registered polynomial root inventories before physical selection. Positivity alone does not decide front ordering or entropy admissibility. Determine all candidates in this class that satisfy positive concentrations, both vector jump balances, ordered fronts and the compressive characteristic conditions below. No theorem about every conceivable weak solution outside this candidate class is requested.
characteristic_and_entropy_checks: Differentiate the FULL coupled storage mapu(c). In conserved variables the flux Jacobian is dc/du=(du/dc)^-1. Retain full registered inverse outputs for du/dc at the feed, selected intermediate and empty states, and complete registered polynomial root inventories for BOTH characteristic velocities at EACH state. A scalar retention formula for an isolated species cannot replace the coupled characteristic calculation. Label the characteristic families by increasing speed. For a familykshock from state left to state right, require lambda_k(left)>s>lambda_k(right) and the standard other-family Lax inequalities: every lower family speed on the left is below s and every higher family speed on the right is above s. Certify both selected fronts continuously from the exact states/equations; do not merely note a small jump-balance residual or fit a sampled outlet curve.
profile_and_mass_accounting: Report the trailing/leading speeds, chronological first/second outlet arrival times, selected intermediate concentrations, and the complete outlet concentrations at every supplied signal time. Define step values at an arrival through their one-sided limits; no observation is located exactly on a front. Quantify any weak-species roll-up above its inlet concentration. Derive column inventory and cumulative outlet mass as piecewise functions of time by clipping front positions at the column length; integrate u(c), including adsorbed mass. Verify injected mass =stored mass+cumulative effluent for EACH species before either front exits, between exits and after both exits. Report both stored species masses at time 1.5 and at strong-species breakthrough, plus cumulative outlet masses at time 1.5 and weak effluent integrated up to strong breakthrough. A weak concentration plateau above feed does not establish production if the storage/flux balances explain it.
scope: This is a fixed ideal equilibrium-column model with separately calibrated detector and isotherm assumptions. Front admissibility, finite-dimensional candidate uniqueness, mass conservation and microscopic kinetic validation are distinct. Agreement at a handful of detector times cannot prove instantaneous microscopic equilibration or zero dispersion in an actual column. The common capacity and all units are explicit; do not silently replace the conservation law by partial_t c+v(c)*partial_z c with independent scalar velocities.

interpretation_proposals.A: A concentration overshoot can be a conservative displacement effect after stored adsorbate is released by a competing solute.
interpretation_proposals.B: Any positive solution of a vector Rankine-Hugoniot polynomial is automatically the physically ordered chromatographic front.
interpretation_proposals.C: Detector cross-sensitivity must be separated from composition before assigning an observed overshoot to a particular species.
interpretation_proposals.D: The mobile-phase concentration integral alone is the complete inventory of an adsorbing column.
interpretation_proposals.E: Coupled characteristic velocities and compressiveness can reject jump-balance candidates that pass positivity.
interpretation_proposals.F: The two shock velocities must equal the independent dilute retention velocities of the two isolated solutes.
interpretation_proposals.G: Agreement at several ideal-model sample times proves instantaneous microscopic adsorption and zero dispersion in every real column.
interpretation_proposals.H: Correct conservation must hold through front exits as well as within each constant-state region.

reporting: Use the public answer schema. Numeric absolute tolerance1e-7. Detector matrix rows are channels 1,2 and columns species1,2. Effluent rows are the five elapsed times in increasing order. Characteristic arrays are increasing within each named state; shock speeds are trailing then leading, while arrival times are first then second. All masses use the conserved storage normalization above. Exact counts, species identity, ordering/admissibility booleans and interpretation IDs remain exact. Preserve full calibration, inverse, root and detector-product evidence and the piecewise mass/entropy arguments in the trajectory.

primary_context.title: Estimating the parameters of competitive Langmuir adsorption isotherms from measured responses to rectangular pulse injections exploiting equilibrium theory
primary_context.role: Primary open-access context for equilibrium column mass balances and binary competitive Langmuir interpretation. This task instead specifies its own common-capacity continuous-feed model, calibration rows and bounded two-front construction; it does not reproduce the article pulse-injection ECP experiment, figures, text or measured data.
